change: Ask for notifications after the first completed juggling recording or successfully counted import, once the player returns to Home.

behavior.allow: Enables the existing server practice schedule automatically
behavior.schedule: Monday, Wednesday and Sunday at the saved local time, default 18:00
behavior.deny: Leaves practice reminders off; no repeated automatic request
behavior.existing_practice_choice: Preserved, including opt-out and selected time
behavior.already_decided_system_permission: Does not silently opt an export-only user into practice reminders
behavior.recording_or_replay: Completion makes the prompt eligible; no dialog is shown until Home is active and clear of other flows
behavior.leaving_home: Cancels presentation before the OS request starts without consuming the one-time opportunity
behavior.other_dialogs: After the notification prompt appears, tracking and app-update prompts wait until another app launch

checks: No permission prompt on Home before a completed session
Native notification dialog on Home after persisted completion signal
Allow turns on practice without visiting a separate enrollment screen
Reminder time remains editable in Settings
An app-update notice does not appear after the permission prompt in the same launch
Update notice can appear on the next launch

broader_tracking_tests.failure: testBundledSettingsKeepAutomaticCollectionOffAndTestsNeverMeasure expects JuggleDudeMetaAdsEnabled=true, whereas Release120Preview-Info.plist intentionally sets it false. No tracking implementation/configuration was changed.

limitations: The UI test supplies the persisted session-completion flag; it does not record or analyze a new video. The production hook is the existing successful session-summary path for both recordings and imports.
Physical phones were not installed or tested in this change.
No real APNs message was sent and no server configuration changed. Physical-device registration, scheduled delivery and tap routing still need the updated preview build.
